html:
This page is a list of Creatures that cannot be reached. In some cases they can be killed with ranged attacks, but in other cases they are completely inaccessible.

Rookgaard

Unkillable

  • A Minotaur Mage past the locked door in Minotaur Hell.
  • A Ghoul behind the wall in the Katana Quest room.

Thais

Unkillable

  • The Demons in the lever room for Lord Retro.
  • A Deepsea Blood Crab and a Crab can be seen from The Tibianic's berth deck.

Kazordoon

Unkillable

  • Some Dwarf Guards and Dwarf Soldiers patrolling the lava bridge past the main gate.
  • In the underwater area of the Nautic Observer house can be seen Quara Pinchers, Quara Constrictors, Crabs, Blood Crabs.
  • A Troll, Frost Troll and Swamp Troll locked in rooms here (32385, 32005, 8).

Venore

Unkillable

  • An Elf locked in a cage in Ulderek's Rock, here (32968, 31760, 7).
  • There are some Pigs and Sheep locked in cages in Tafariel's throne room in the Pits of Inferno.
  • A Banshee in Jakundaf Desert, here (32619, 32105, 12).
  • A Poacher and a Hunter are locked in cages underground in the Amazon Camp.

Carlin

Unkillable

  • A parrot locked in a room in the Explorer's Society post in Northport.
  • Several Deer behind some bushes at Santa's House on Vega. The path is a protection zone, so the deer cannot be attacked.

Edron

Unkillable

  • Some Gnarlhounds behind the bars in the Modified Gnarlhound room.

Ankrahmun

Unkillable

  • A Vampire and a Behemoth in the Serpentine Tower.
  • 2 Poison Spiders and a Giant Spider on a hill next to the Mountain Tomb entrance.

Tiquanda

Killable

  • A Crab on a small island on the south-west coast of the jungle, here (32558, 32870, 7).

Unkillable

  • Several Spiders in unreachable rooms of the Tarantula Caves.
  • Some Hydras in cages in Chor.
  • A Tiger in a cage in the lower deck of Port Hope boat.

Vandura

Unkillable

  • A Demon in Theodore Loveless' cellar in Liberty Bay.

Hrodmir

Unkillable

  • An Ice Witch and some War Wolves behind a wall in the last room in Bittermor.

Quirefang

Unkillable

  • A Rotworm, two Rabbit, two Deers, a Bear and a Giant Spider in east Fiehonja.

Yalahar

Killable

  • Some Yalahari before the portal to the final battle of In Service of Yalahar Quest.

Unkillable

  • Some Rotworms and a Carrion Worm in the cellar of Soilance's shop.
  • A Nightmare Scion in a cage in the Arena and Zoo Quarter.
  • A Bandit in the south-east of the Trade Quarter, here (32863, 31361, 6).
  • Various rooms and corridors with Dwarves near the throne room of Beregar.
  • Some Troll Legionnaires one floor above the troll ambush room of the troll's hideout, here (32752, 31514, 15).

Zao

Unkillable

  • Several Haunted Treelings at the top of Vengoth/Castle.
